cohort: The study included 36 women with gestational diabetes mellitus who had previously undergone metabolic surgery, primarily sleeve gastrectomy.
finding: Nutritional deficiencies (carbohydrate inadequacy and micronutrient deficiency) and a high rate of composite adverse neonatal outcomes were common in women with gestational diabetes after metabolic surgery, suggesting these pregnancies may be higher risk.
mod_finding: Unplanned Caesarean delivery occurred in 16.7% of women.
birth_weight: Neonatal birthweight was observed to be higher in women with pre-pregnancy BMI >= 30 kg/m2 and those requiring insulin.
gest_age: Gestational diabetes was diagnosed at 25 (±6) weeks, and women birthed at 38 (±1) weeks.
